channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kris Dunn | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kris Dunn from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Kris Dunn
item.description:
Justin Russo:Kawhi Leonard, on Kris Dunn:

“He’s a tremendous piece for us, comes in every night guarding the best player, doing anything he can to slow them down, and tonight he had 5 steals. He’s making his open shots when he gets them and he’s been playing great.”

Kawhi Leonard on Kris Dunn, Jan 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Michael Porter Jr on Kris Dunn, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Bennett Durando:Michael Porter Jr on maybe seeing Kawhi Leonard matched up on him:

“Amazing on-ball defender. It’s gonna be fun for me just because he is one of the best defenders in the NBA.I think that they’ll mix it up. They’ll probably put Kris Dunn and Kawhi back & forth on me and Jamal.”

Michael Porter Jr on Kris Dunn, Kawhi Leonard, Apr 17, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: John Collins on Kris Dunn
item.description:
Sarah K. Spencer:More from John Collins on Kris Dunn:

“The whole year, Kris has been the No. 1 cheerleader, or supporter. He's definitely been the loudest in the locker room,cheering for the guys, and I think that says a lot.”

John Collins on Kris Dunn, Apr 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @sarah_k_spence.

item.title: Coby White on Kris Dunn
item.description:
Coby White, on competing for starting PG spot:

“I've been competing all my life within the team. Competing is in my blood and DNA. We're going to go at it for sure. Kris Dunn is a great player. I think it's really cool we have the same agent.”

Coby White on Kris Dunn, Jun 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Kris Dunn
item.description:
KC Johnson:Fred Hoiberg on Kris Dunn:

“When you see the fall and chip out of the floor, the fact he didn’t lose his teeth completely is unbelievable. He has a lot of pain in his mouth. They put braces on him to try to stabilize the area. But right now, the concern is the concussion.”

Fred Hoiberg on Kris Dunn, Jan 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Reggie Bullock on Kris Dunn
item.description:
Cody Westerlund‏: Pistons'Reggie Bullock on if #Bulls' Kris Dunn fouled him on last-second game-tying layup attempt:

“I looked at the play multiple times -- it's a foul. He came down on my arm. It's a foul.”

Reggie Bullock on Kris Dunn, Jan 14, 2018. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Kris Dunn
item.description:
KC Johnson:Classic Thibodeau on Dunn:

“We think he's a good fit. We're a 29-win team. So there's a lot of room for improvement.”

Tom Thibodeau on Kris Dunn, Jul 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Austin Ainge on Kris Dunn
item.description:
Brian Robb:Austin Ainge on agents withholding medical info:

“It doesn’t happen that often & I don’t know how influential it is. We know Kris Dunn pretty well”

Austin Ainge on Kris Dunn, Jun 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.

item.title: Austin Ainge on Ben Simmons, Kris Dunn, Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Brian Robb:Austin Ainge on whether Dunn, Ingram or Simmons will work out for the Celtics:

“Probably not on at least two of those...but we keep asking.”

Austin Ainge on Ben Simmons, Kris Dunn, Brandon Ingram, Jun 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.
